subject.title: fix(ios): "Jump to latest" no longer appears while the assistant is still writing

question: Should this protected Apple UI fix merge on the uninspectable simulator claim, or should it require an attached redacted after-fix artifact first?
rationale: The source change is narrow, but only a maintainer can waive the external real-behavior-proof gate for a protected PR when the claimed simulator result is not independently visible.

options.title: Request inspectable simulator proof
options.body: Require a redacted recording, screenshot sequence, terminal transcript, or linked XCUITest artifact that demonstrates the three live-edge states before merging.

options.title: Accept the reported simulator run
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the reported local XCUITest without an artifact if they independently trust and verify the Apple UI behavior.

recommendation.title: Request inspectable simulator proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted recording, screenshot sequence, terminal transcript, or linked XCUITest artifact that demonstrates the three live-edge states before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the proposed Apple chat-reader change and reported the simulator validation in the PR body.
